name: titan
description: Language support for the Titan programming language

titan.completion.insertCallSnippets.markdownDescription: Insert parentheses and editable parameter placeholders when completing functions and methods. Disable this to insert only the name when taking function or bound-method references. Existing call or generic arguments are preserved. Changing this setting restarts the affected language server.

titan.languageServer.path.markdownDescription: Path to the Titan language-server executable. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder. Leave empty to use the executable packaged at `bin/titan-language-server`.

titan.languageServer.arguments.description: Additional arguments passed to the Titan language-server executable.

titan.languageServer.logLevel.markdownDescription: Structured log level emitted by the server before the **Titan Language Server** output channel applies its own display filter. The `debug` default lets the channel's VS Code log level control normal and debug visibility. Set this to `trace` to make trace records available, or to a less verbose level to reduce server logging. Changing this setting restarts the affected language server.

titan.trace.server.markdownDescription: Trace LSP messages exchanged with the Titan language server in the **Titan Language Server** output channel. `verbose` includes message payloads and may contain source text.

titan.compiler.luaPath.markdownDescription: Lua module search path passed to the language server as `TITAN_LS_LUA_PATH` so its embedded Lua can find the Titan compiler modules. Leave empty to use the compiler Lua tree bundled at `dist/titan/share/lua/5.5`; the server does not inherit ambient `LUA_PATH`.

titan.compiler.luaCPath.markdownDescription: Native Lua module search path passed to the language server as `TITAN_LS_LUA_CPATH` for compiler dependencies. Leave empty to use the native Lua tree bundled at `dist/titan/lib/lua/5.5`; this is not a `lib/titan` provider path, and the server does not inherit ambient `LUA_CPATH`.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run stage-notices
scripts.compile: npm run check-types && node scripts/esbuild.mjs && npm run stage-lua-modules
scripts.test:vscode: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && vscode-test
